outcome: Clinical characteristics of COVID-19 in pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant and postpartum women with COVID-19 infection
finding: COVID-19 infection during pregnancy did not have a major effect on maternal and neonatal outcomes, with cesarean section and preterm birth rates similar to the COVID-19 negative pregnant population.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean section in COVID-19 positive women was similar to the rate in COVID-19 negative pregnant women.
